outputs.note: 1:10m land, clipped to the basemap frame
1:50m land for a wider frame; draw under `land` so a pitched camera never sees an edge
US places with pop_max >= 150k or state/national capitals >= 50k; Canada and Mexico >= 500k or national capital
US Interstates; Canada/Mexico major highways with min_zoom <= 6
Lower-48 states + DC polygons (large lakes cut out), with NE label points
admin-1 boundary lines for USA, Canada, Mexico
country polygons in the frame (USA, Canada, Mexico, Caribbean, Central America)
international land borders in the frame

build.command: cd lab && uv run python -I scripts/recon_geo.py
build.simplify: shapely.simplify(preserve_topology=True) 0.005 deg (land_context 0.02 deg); coordinates rounded to 4 decimals (land_context 3)
